extracted.intended_audience: members of the public and stakeholders (commenters, regulated parties, and state/local officials) interested in EPA's proposed approval of Maryland's Underground Storage Tank (UST) program
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and procedural requirements for submitting public comments on EPA's proposed approval of Maryland's UST program revisions (Docket EPA-R03-UST-2025-0091), and summary of how EPA will act on comments and finalize approval. Includes where to find official documents and technical/contact instructions for submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comments deadline
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you want to comment on EPA's proposed approval of Maryland's revisions to its state UST program, you must do so at this time. (The document also notes 'Comments are no longer being accepted. See DATES for details.' — check DATES for the authoritative deadline.)

rubrics_metrics.name: How to submit comments (methods and Docket ID)
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit your comments, identified by Docket ID No. EPA-R03-UST-2025-0091, by one of the following methods: Federal eRulemaking Portal (https://www.regulations.gov) or Email to uybarreta.thomas@epa.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the on-line instructions for submitting comments via Regulations.gov. Direct your comments to Docket ID No. EPA-R03-UST-2025-0091. If you submit an electronic comment, EPA recommends including your name and other contact information in the body of your comment. If submitting by email directly to EPA, your email address will be automatically captured and included as part of the comment placed in the public docket.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not submit CBI or otherwise-protected information through public portals
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not submit information that you consider to be Confidential Business Information (CBI) or otherwise protected through https://www.regulations.gov or email.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EPA's policy is that all comments received will be included in the public docket without change and may be available online, unless the comment includes information claimed to be CBI or other information whose disclosure is restricted by statute. Agencies may redact or withhold certain submissions (or portions thereof).

rubrics_metrics.name: Public docket disclosure policy and anonymity
rubrics_metrics.description: EPA's policy is that all comments received will be included in the public docket without change and may be available online, unless restricted by statute.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Federal website Regulations.gov is an 'anonymous access' system, which means EPA will not know your identity or contact information unless you provide it in the body of your comment. Submitted comments may not be available to be read until the agency has approved them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure comments are legible and technically accessible
rubrics_metrics.description: If EPA cannot read your comment due to technical difficulties, and cannot contact you for clarification, EPA may not be able to consider your comment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include clear contact information in the body of electronic submissions so EPA can follow up if necessary. If you submit an electronic comment, EPA recommends that you include your name and other contact information in the body of your comment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electronic file formatting and security requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Electronic files should avoid the use of special characters, any form of encryption, and be free of any defects or viruses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure uploaded files are readable and non-encrypted; avoid special characters that may prevent processing. Files with defects or viruses can prevent EPA from accessing the comment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assistance for non-English speakers and persons with disabilities
rubrics_metrics.description: If you need assistance in a language other than English, or you are a person with disabilities who needs a reasonable accommodation at no cost to you, contact the EPA person listed in the notice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reach out to the EPA contact person by email or phone (Thomas UyBarreta, (215) 814-2953, uybarreta.thomas@epa.gov) for assistance or accommodation. If unable to submit electronically, contact the EPA contact person for help.

rubrics_metrics.name: Where to find supporting documents and official materials
rubrics_metrics.description: You can review and copy the documents that form the basis for this proposed action and associated publicly available materials through https://www.regulations.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The document also links to the PDF on govinfo.gov for the official electronic format. The FederalRegister.gov XML rendition is an unofficial informational resource and users should verify against official editions on govinfo.gov. Only official editions provide legal notice per 44 U.S.C. 1503 & 1507.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program-approval substantive standard (high-level)
rubrics_metrics.description: EPA is proposing to approve revisions to the State of Maryland's Underground Storage Tank (UST) program based on EPA's determination that these revisions satisfy all the requirements needed for program approval.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EPA proposes to codify its approval and to incorporate by reference those provisions of Maryland's regulations and statutes that EPA has determined meet the requirements for approval. Those provisions will be subject to EPA's inspection and enforcement authorities under sections 9005 and 9006 of RCRA Subtitle I and other applicable statutory and regulatory provisions. (Specific statutory/regulatory requirements for approval are not enumerated on this notice; see supporting documents/docket for details.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct final rule and response-to-comments process
rubrics_metrics.description: EPA published a direct final rule approving this action; if no significant negative comment is received, EPA will not take further action on the proposed rulemaking and the direct final rule will be effective 60 days from publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If EPA receives a significant negative comment, it will withdraw the direct final rule and proceed with the proposed rule (and further action). Therefore, submitting comments can affect whether the direct final rule becomes effective.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document identification and use of official format
rubrics_metrics.description: This document has been published in the Federal Register (FR Doc. 2025-17518, 90 FR 43987). Use the PDF linked in the document sidebar for the official electronic format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FederalRegister.gov provides an XML prototype that is informational only; verify content against the official PDF on govinfo.gov for legal research and to confirm official publication details.
